summary: Phase 3 e2e validation. Backend pytest 27/27 passing — added 11 new tests (TestGetLeadById, TestNoteEditDelete, TestCsv) covering GET /api/leads/{id} owner+cross-user 404, PUT/DELETE /api/leads/{lead_id}/notes/{note_id} (success, empty 400, cross-user 404), CSV export header/rows + per-user isolation, CSV import (created=2, errors=3 for 3 missing-required-field rows, BadSource/BadStatus fall back to Other/New, deal_value persisted), and non-csv 400. Frontend Playwright validated dashboard CSV buttons render, Export downloads file with correct header (lead_name,company_name,email,phone,source,deal_value,status,next_follow_up) and 1 user-owned data row (became 3 after import + seeded leads), Import file picker → csv-result-dialog shows '1 leads imported successfully' + '1 row(s) skipped: Row 3: missing lead_name/company_name/email'. Opened lead row → LeadDetailSheet → open-full-page-link → /leads/:id renders lead-detail-page with header (status badge + source caption + lead_name + company), 3 KPI cards (Deal value $250, Next follow-up Mar 1 2026, Contact email/phone), Quick actions (Mark Contacted/Won/Lost), Edit/Delete buttons. NotesPanel: add note appears in notes-list as note-{id}; hover reveals edit/delete; note-edit-{id} → fill → note-edit-save-{id} updated text to 'Edited note text'; note-delete-{id} → note-delete-confirm removed it ('Note deleted' toast).
action_items: Carry-over from iteration_2 (still applies, optional): update_lead drops explicit null next_follow_up via model_dump() filter; switch to model_dump(exclude_unset=True) so detail-followup-clear and LeadFormDialog clear-date both null the field server-side. Phase 3 detail page also uses PUT next_follow_up:null for clear which is silently ignored.

Optional: GET /api/leads/{lead_id} is registered AFTER the notes routes and BEFORE /leads/export/csv and /leads/import/csv. Order works because dynamic param matches a single segment, but consider grouping all dynamic-id routes together for readability.
Optional: POST /api/leads still returns 200 (REST convention is 201).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py update_lead: model_dump filter drops legitimate clear-to-null requests (carry-over).

CsvActions.handleExport uses fetch with credentials:'include' instead of api/axios; works because session_token cookie is set, but bypasses the centralized api.js Bearer-fallback logic — Bearer-only test sessions cannot use the export button without cookies.
import_leads_csv catches all per-row exceptions but never logs them; silent failures could hide bugs. Add logger.exception(...) before appending to errors.
LeadDetailPage and LeadDetailSheet duplicate KPI/contact/follow-up rendering; consider extracting a shared <LeadStatsCards/> component.
NotesPanel does not optimistic-update; each mutation re-fetches the full list (acceptable for small N but could cause flicker for large lists).
